8.功能格類型#8-1.起點：經過起點（不用停留），除了功能格與當前受祝福影響的格子，都會刷新獎勵。每次經過起點還可以抽取拉霸機獎勵，並累積鳥居的觸發次數。##8-2.賭場：同時擲出兩個骰子（不會消耗道具），擲出相同點數即可獲得點數合計數量的標準骰子。如果沒有擲出相同點數，最多可重骰 1 次。##8-3.岔路：停留在岔路格上，下次前進時會改從岔路方向開始走。##8-4.祝福：停留在祝福格上，會天降隕石，將原本獎勵格上的道具轉變成鬼火x3。##8-5.變身：金禮子騎上熊開始衝刺，一口氣收集路上一整排的獎勵。##8-6.佛像：每次經過佛像，可使格子上的鬼火數量+2；若停留在佛像格上，可以參拜祈禱一次領取所有累計的鬼火。|8. Special Tile Types #8-1. Start: When you pass the starting point (no need to stop), all tiles except for special tiles and those currently affected by blessings will have their rewards refreshed. Each time you pass Start, you can also spin the slot machine for a reward and increase your Torii trigger count. ##8-2. Casino: Roll two dice simultaneously (no items consumed). If both dice show the same number, you'll receive a number of standard dice equal to the sum of the two dice. If you don't roll matching numbers, you may re-roll once at most. ##8-3. Fork: When you land on a Fork tile, the next time you move, you'll start moving in the direction of the fork. ##8-4. Blessing: If you stop on a Blessing tile, a meteor will fall from the sky, transforming the item on a normal reward tile into 3 Will-o'-the-wisps. ##8-5. Transformation: Kinreiko hops on a bear and dashes forward, collecting an entire row of rewards in one go. ##8-6. Buddha Statue: Each time you pass a Buddha statue, the number of Will-o'-the-wisps on that tile increases by 2. If you land on a Buddha statue tile, you can offer a prayer and collect all the accumulated Will-o'-the-wisps there.┤
